title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Illegally Manufacturing, Trading, Transporting, or Storing Prohibited Highly Toxic Chemicals such as Tetramine

articles.content_en:
Article 1 Whoever illegally manufactures, buys, sells, transports, or stores toxic rodenticide or other banned highly toxic chemicals, thereby endangering public security, and falls under any of the following circumstances, shall be convicted and sentenced for the crime of illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing dangerous substances in accordance with Article 125 of the Criminal Law, and shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years:
(1) illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing 50 grams or more of crude powder, liquid concentrate, or preparation, or 2 kilograms or more of bait; or
(2) causing serious injury or death to any person, or causing losses of public or private property of 100,000 yuan or more, during the course of illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing.

Article 2 Whoever illegally manufactures, buys, sells, transports, or stores toxic rodenticide or other banned highly toxic chemicals, and falls under any of the following circumstances, shall be deemed to have committed a "serious circumstance" as provided in Article 125 of the Criminal Law, and shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, life imprisonment, or the death penalty:
(1) illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing 500 grams or more of crude powder, liquid concentrate, or preparation, or 20 kilograms or more of bait;
(2) causing serious injury or death to three or more persons, or causing losses of public or private property of 200,000 yuan or more, during the course of illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing; or
(3) illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing 50 grams or more but less than 500 grams of crude powder, liquid concentrate, or preparation, or 2 kilograms or more but less than 20 kilograms of bait, and combined with other serious circumstances.

Article 3 Where a unit illegally manufactures, buys, sells, transports, or stores toxic rodenticide or other banned highly toxic chemicals, the conviction and sentencing standards prescribed in Articles 1 and 2 of this Interpretation shall apply.

Article 4 Any state functionary who is responsible for investigating and punishing the acts of illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing toxic rodenticide or other banned highly toxic chemicals, and who abuses his or her power or neglects his or her duties, thereby causing significant losses to public property or the interests of the State or the people, shall be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of abuse of power or the crime of dereliction of duty in accordance with Article 397 of the Criminal Law.

Article 5 Prior to the coming into force of this Interpretation, if a person illegally manufactured, bought, sold, transported, or stored bait of toxic rodenticide or other banned highly toxic chemicals for self-use, truly out of production or daily life needs, and has not caused serious harm to society, the act may be deemed not to constitute a crime in accordance with Article 13 of the Criminal Law.
After the coming into force of this Interpretation, if a person illegally manufactures, buys, sells, transports, or stores bait of toxic rodenticide or other banned highly toxic chemicals for self-use, truly out of production or daily life needs, and the act constitutes a crime but has not caused serious harm to society, and the person shows genuine repentance after education, the punishment may be given a lighter or mitigated sentence or be exempted from punishment according to law.

Article 6 The term "toxic rodenticide and other banned highly toxic chemicals" as used in this Interpretation refers to toxic rodenticide, fluoroacetamide, sodium fluoroacetate, silatrane, and gliftor (see the attached table) that are expressly prohibited by the State.
